ideas.pitch: Inspired by the values of Swami Vivekananda, this platform uses NLP and LLMs to analyze student discussion forums, community service logs, and essay submissions to measure character development, empathy, and leadership growth over time.
ideas.title: ValuesGuard AI: Ethics and Character Analytics for Educational Institutions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the mission of the Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda Institute of Values, the co-organizer of the hackathon, making it resonate deeply with the judges' core themes.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered logistics and matching application that connects lonely seniors in urban Delhi with nearby college student volunteers for social outings, temple visits, and medical check-ups.
ideas.title: ElderLink Delhi: Volunteer-Powered Senior Social and Healthcare Escort Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven grand-prize-winning social impact pattern by addressing urban isolation and elder care directly relevant to the Delhi NCR demographic.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite imagery monitoring platform that detects illegal industrial dumping, unauthorized land use changes, and environmental violations across industrial zones in Delhi-NCR using computer vision.
ideas.title: EcoAudit AI: Satellite-Based Industrial Land Compliance Monitor for NCR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a pressing regional environmental pain point familiar to judges living and working in Delhi, following the runner-up satellite monitoring pattern.

ideas.pitch: A personalized nutrition and meal-planning web app tailored specifically for university mess menus and Indian traditional diets, optimizing for macro-nutrients and local affordability.
ideas.title: ArogyaNutri: Regional AI Diet and Nutrition Advisor for Indian Universities
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact formula of the Hour Hackathon winner by building a localized health utility with immediate relevance to university students in the room.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized platform connecting DTU and Delhi university students with local MSMEs for short-term technical projects, featuring automated task verification and transparent escrow-style tracking.
ideas.title: SkillBridge Delhi: Autonomous Micro-Internship and Mentorship Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the employment and skill-gap crisis directly for students and local businesses in Delhi, appealing to the entrepreneurial spirit of DTU innovation cells.
